_comment: ATS watchlist, polled daily by watch.mjs. EVERY slug here must have been VERIFIED by querying the API (node probe.mjs "Company Name"). Never guess a slug: a wrong one is indistinguishable from a company with no openings. `applied: true` means an application already went out, so the one-application-per-company rule applies and new reqs there are reported for information only.

_known_collisions._note: Slugs that answer but belong to a DIFFERENT company than the name suggests. Listed here so discovery never re-adds them.
_known_collisions.neon: the Ashby board under this slug is a games payments platform, not Neon Postgres
_known_collisions.prisma: the Greenhouse board under this slug is an Argentinian fintech, not prisma.io

_no_public_api._note: Targets with no queryable board: Avature, SuccessFactors, Taleo, bespoke career sites. They stay manual, with a cadence and a trigger, in the skill's phase 1c table.
